name: Daily Order: Ore for the Forges
description: The smiths are burning through iron faster than the carters can haul it, and will pay for a few loads dug fresh from a seam.

start_condition.start_hint: Ask the vault keeper in any town: orders are posted there day and night.

stages.description: Work two rock faces at any mining seam.
Bring four iron ore to any vault keeper.

objectives.description: Deliver the ore to any vault keeper.
